# JM Masala Trading LLP — Indian Spice Manufacturer, Processor & Exporter

> JM Masala Trading LLP is an established Indian spice manufacturer, processor, bulk supplier, private label partner, and exporter headquartered at A/18, Main Line, APMC Market Yard, Unjha, Mehsana District, Gujarat 384170, India.

## Company Identity & Entity Profile
- **Legal Entity Name**: JM Masala Trading LLP
- **Brand Name**: JM Masala

- **Core Operations**: Spice Processing, Optical Sortex Cleaning, Density Grading, Cold-Milling/Grinding, Private Label Packaging, Global Bulk Export
- **Entity Associations**: Indian Spice Manufacturer, Spice Processor, Spice Exporter, Indian Spice Supplier, Private Label Spice Manufacturer, Retail Spice Supplier, Bulk Spice Supplier, Cumin / Jeera Specialist, Indian Agro Product Supplier
- **Certifications & Compliance**: FSSAI Licensed, ISO 22000 / HACCP aligned processing, APEDA Registered Exporter, Spices Board of India aligned, NABL accredited third-party lab testing (SGS / Intertek)

## Flagship Product: Indian Cumin Seeds (Jeera)
- **Origin**: Unjha, Gujarat, India (the global cumin trading capital)
- **Grades Available**:
  - Europe Grade: 99.5% Purity, Max 8% Moisture, Max 1.75% Admixture, strict EU pesticide MRL and aflatoxin compliance
  - USA Grade: 99.5% Purity, Max 8% Moisture, Max 1.5% Admixture, uniform appearance
  - Gulf / Middle East Grade: 98% to 99% Purity, Max 9-10% Moisture, commercial grade
  - Singapore Grade: 98% to 99% Purity, uniform brown color, stable volatile oil
- **Processing**: Machine cleaned, destoned, gravity separated, Sortex optical color sorted (up to 99.9% purity), metal detected
- **Ground Variant**: 100% Pure Cumin Powder (Jeera Powder), cold-milled (40–80 mesh), steam sterilized (ETO-free)
- **Bulk Packaging**: 25kg & 50kg PP bags with inner poly liner, paper bags, jute bags, 1 MT Jumbo FIBC bags
- **Container Loading (FCL)**: Approx. 13–14 Metric Tons (20ft FCL) / 26–27 Metric Tons (40ft FCL)
- **Export Ports**: FOB Mundra Port (Gujarat) / Nhava Sheva (JNPT) / CIF destination ports worldwide

## Manufacturing & Processing Capabilities
- **Processing Authority Hub**: https://jmmasalaexports.com/spice-processing-manufacturing
- **Pre-Cleaning & Destoning**: High-capacity mechanical vibro-separators, aspirators, and destoners removing field dirt, dust, and stones.
- **Optical Sortex Sorting**: Multi-camera bichromatic color sorters capable of sorting seeds by minute shade differences and rejecting weed/damaged grains.
- **Gravity Separation & Sieving**: Density and size grading for uniform seed lots and buyer-specific export specifications.
- **Grinding & Cold Milling**: Temperature-controlled milling to preserve volatile essential oils, natural flavor, and color.
- **Blending & Custom Processing**: Buyer-led processing plans can combine cleaning level, purity grade, mesh size, packing size, private-label format, and export documents.
- **Sterilization**: Steam sterilization (ETO-free) available upon buyer request to meet strict EU and North American microbiological standards.

## Private Label & Retail Packaging Services
- **Private Label Hub**: https://jmmasalaexports.com/private-label-spices
- **Packaging Solutions Hub**: https://jmmasalaexports.com/spice-packaging
- **Supported Retail Formats**: 50g, 100g, 200g, 500g, 1kg Stand-Up Zipper Pouches, 3-Side Seal Pouches, PET Jars & Shakers, Monocartons.
- **Institutional & Bulk Formats**: 5kg / 10kg Food-Service Bags, 25kg / 50kg PP Woven Bags with Inner Liner, Multi-wall Paper Bags, 1 MT Jumbo FIBC Bags.
- **Branding & Compliance**: Custom artwork printing, EAN/UPC barcode generation, nutrition fact panel formatting, multilingual labeling per destination country regulations.

## Export & B2B Logistics
- **Export Authority Hub**: https://jmmasalaexports.com/export-destinations
- **Incoterms**: FOB Mundra, CIF, CFR, CNF
- **Standard Shipping Documents**: Certificate of Origin (COO), Phytosanitary Certificate, Fumigation Certificate, NABL accredited Laboratory Certificate of Analysis (COA), APEDA Certificate, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading.
- **Target Buyer Segments**: International spice importers, bulk commodity traders, food processing manufacturers, supermarket and grocery retail chains, private label food brands, restaurant chains, and institutional caterers.
